Title: Public preview: Azure Synapse Link for Azure Cosmos DB Gremlin API

Body.Content:
Azure Synapse Link for Azure Cosmos DB is a cloud-native hybrid transactional and analytical processing (HTAP) capability enabling you with near real time analytics over operational data in Azure Cosmos DB. Initially available for CORE (SQL) and MongoDB APIs, if you use the Gremlin API, you can now also use Azure Synapse Link for BI, reporting, data science, and graph analytics like centrality, connectivity, shortest path, and community detection.

Learn more.
